steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and publishing.
Set the project title required for publishing.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply the offered RFQ pricing template.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Set the line item's delivery location as required.

args.goal: On the buyer's eRFX project screen, open Add T&Cs, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set Payment within 45 days to Required, leave Delivery within 7 days as None, click Done, and stop on the project create screen.

steps.note: Configure the project-level required and optional clauses, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Invite one QA test vendor for Vendor A's bidding session.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ project.
Verify the project was created and reached its published event page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the required project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the optional project-level clause is also shown to the vendor.
Accept only the required clause.
Leave the optional delivery clause unaccepted.
Quote 100 for the line and submit the vendor bid.
Verify that the vendor bid was accepted and submitted.
